thread:
jake_support: Heads-up — Helios Retail (CUST-8842) opened a ticket: invoice INV-2026-445 was paid on 2026-03-01 but their AP requires a PO on the invoice. They want the PO added after-the-fact. Amount $12,450.00. Can we append PO or do we need credit + rebill? Link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-445

tessa_finance: We cannot change an issued & settled invoice number/amount after payment. Standard process is to issue a full credit memo and then generate a new invoice with the PO. If they want no money movement we can apply the credit to the new invoice then re-charge using the saved payment token (if customer approves).

sam_billing: +1. Need payment txn id and payment method token to attempt a capture on the new invoice. Also confirm whether the customer expects a refund to card or prefers card-charging flow. Please provide gateway txn id.

jake_support: Customer replied: "we prefer not to take a refund; we want a corrected invoice for AP so we can match the payment. If you can issue a credit memo and immediately re-invoice and charge the same card, that's fine." They gave permission to reuse the payment method.

elaine_se: Quick note — we can add a non-financial "PO" metadata field to the invoice in the portal for their records, but that won't satisfy accounting teams that require a matching invoice number/PO on the actual tax invoice. Finance will still require credit+rebill for audit trail.

sam_billing: OK. Requested info from customer: gateway txn id, card last4, and confirmation to re-charge. Jake, can you paste the txn id here?

jake_support: Gateway txn id: stripe_pi_3Kk9b2xxxx (masked). Card last4: 4242. Customer confirmed re-charge permission.

ops-bot: Billing action requested by tessa_finance. Status changed to: pending-finance-ops

tessa_finance: Plan of action (steps for billing ops):
1) Create credit memo for INV-2026-445 for full amount ($12,450.00). Reason: "PO added post-payment (customer request)". Use GL code REBILL-PO-ADJ.
2) Generate new invoice INV-2026-445-R1 with identical line items, add PO# 2026-HELIOS-77 in invoice header and invoice metadata.
3) Apply credit memo to the new invoice (to avoid refund to card).
4) Charge the saved payment method via stripe using the original payment token. If capture fails, notify customer immediately and offer manual refund + ACH/paper check options.

Commands for ops (internal admin tool):
```
admin-billing credit --invoice INV-2026-445 --amount 12450 --reason "PO added post-payment" --gl REBILL-PO-ADJ
admin-billing create-invoice --customer CUST-8842 --template INV-2026-445 --new-ref INV-2026-445-R1 --po 2026-HELIOS-77
admin-billing charge --invoice INV-2026-445-R1 --payment-token stripe_pi_3Kk9b2xx --capture
```

DB check examples (ops):
```
SELECT id, status, gateway_txn_id, amount, payment_method FROM payments WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2026-445';
SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE id LIKE 'INV-2026-445%';
```

sam_billing: I'll take the credit + create new invoice steps. Flagging for manager approval to reuse payment token (compliance). cc: @tessa_finance for GL review.

jake_support: Noted — customer okayed reuse. I pasted the signed confirmation and ticket link in the billing ticket.

tessa_finance: Approved to reuse token for this customer (we have consent in ticket). Sam, proceed with credit + reissue and try to apply credit before capture. If capture succeeds, mark original invoice refunded->closed and new invoice paid. If capture fails, escalate to finance for refund path.

ops-bot: Billing action completed by sam_billing: credit-created credit_89321, invoice-created INV-2026-445-R1, payment-attempt queued.

sam_billing: Charge went through — new invoice INV-2026-445-R1 paid (txn stripe_pi_3Kk9b2zz). Applied credit memo credit_89321. Closing loop: original invoice shows refunded via credit memo, new invoice contains PO 2026-HELIOS-77, customer notified with updated PDF.

jake_support: Customer confirmed they received the corrected invoice PDF and AP accepted it. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
